ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is an Arctic food web diagram, marking organisms such as Man, Arctic Wolves, Polar Bears, Kittiwakes, Snowy Owls, Arctic Foxes, Brown Bears, Pikas, Musk Ox, Caribou, Lemmings, Arctic Hares, Liverworts, Grasses, Caribou moss, Lichens, Bacteria and Fungi. Around "Polar Bears", an arrow can be seen pointing upward from "Arctic Foxes" to "Polar Bears", indicating that polar bears feed on arctic foxes or depend on arctic foxes; at the same time, there is also an arrow from "Polar Bears" pointing to "Man". Reasoning: The question assumes that all arctic foxes are depleted. According to food web rules, if a consumer's food source disappears, and the figure does not show that it has other alternative food sources, then this consumer will lose its food source. Therefore, polar bears are very likely to starve until they starve to death.
